```renyi
public function count_words(text: Text) returns List of WordCount
  purpose: Count every lower-cased word, most frequent first.
  example: count_words("a b a")
    is [WordCount(word: "a", occurrences: 2), WordCount(word: "b", occurrences: 1)]
  example: count_words("") is []

  let spaced be text.to_lower().replace("\n", " ").replace("\t", " ")
  let words be
    for each word in spaced.split(" ")
    where word is not ""
    collect word
  let counts be for each word in words group by word count
  let entries be
    for each word in words.distinct()
    collect WordCount(word: word, occurrences: counts.get(word) otherwise 0)
  return
    for each entry in entries
    sorted by entry.occurrences descending
    collect entry
end
```

```
public function count_words(text: Text) returns List of WordCount
  purpose: Count every lower-cased word, most frequent first.
  example: count_words("a b a")
    is [WordCount(word: "a", occurrences: 2), WordCount(word: "b", occurrences: 1)]
  example: count_words("") is []

  let spaced be text.to_lower().replace("\n", " ").replace("\t", " ").replace("\r", " ")
  let words be for each part in spaced.split(" ") where not part.is_empty() collect part
  let mutable entries: List of WordCount be []
  for each word in words.distinct()
    let occurrences be for each other in words where other is word count
    set entries to entries.append(WordCount(word: word, occurrences: occurrences))
  end
  return for each entry in entries sorted by entry.occurrences descending collect entry
end
```

```renyi
public function count_words(text: Text) returns List of WordCount
  purpose: Count every lower-cased word, most frequent first.
  example: count_words("a b a")
    is [WordCount(word: "a", occurrences: 2), WordCount(word: "b", occurrences: 1)]
  example: count_words("") is []

  let mutable counts: Map of Text to Integer be {}
  for each word in text.to_lower().split() where not word.is_empty()
    let seen be counts.get(word) otherwise 0
    set counts to counts.set(key: word, value: seen + 1)
  end
  let mutable entries: List of WordCount be []
  for each word, total in counts
    set entries to entries.append(WordCount(word: word, occurrences: total))
  end
  return for each entry in entries sorted by entry.occurrences descending collect entry
end
```
